about_the_game:
The highly anticipated 1st album from the official FFXIV band that has captivated the world!

THE PRIMALS, the official band of the hit MMORPG, FINAL FANTASY XIV, was formed in 2014 under the direction of sound director Masayoshi Soken. They have rocked FINAL FANTASY XIV FAN FESTIVAL stages across Japan, North America, Europe, and South Korea — thrilling fans worldwide with their fiery, high-energy performances.

Their first solo album as a band — boldly titled THE PRIMALS — celebrates a major milestone in their ever-expanding global journey.

This album includes tracks from previously released arrangement albums, as well as new songs recorded specifically for this release.

Keep an eye out for this ultimate album from the band that has thrilled players around the globe!
